issue.impact: Field upgrade shortcut refresh can fall back to the Universal icon even when the Field executable and installer consume the authorized Field mark.

requirements: Parameterize the refresh shortcut icon path while preserving the existing Universal default.
Keep the shared WebView2 health and shortcut refresh behavior in Universal.
Add a contract test proving an edition wrapper can select its executable icon without copying the shared hook.
Create a thin Field wrapper that selects the Field executable icon and includes the shared Universal hook.
Point only the Field Tauri overlay at the thin wrapper.
Re-run static installer structure verification before requesting a YELLOW preview build.
